Product Features

  • Upholstered Sofa Bed Frame-This sofa bed is made of skin-friendly velvet fabric, the interior is made of high quality MDF, FSC environmental protection material, safe and durable, with good air permeability to give you a comfortable sleep.
  • Pull-out bed frame-There is a second pull-out bed frame at the bottom of this wooden bed frame. The two bed frames can be joined together to form a size of 180 x 200 cm, making it easy to create a single bed or a double bed.
  • Space-saving design-The clearing bed at the bottom of the sofa bed can be easily pulled out or pushed in, which greatly saves space. Ideal for small rooms or apartments and guest rooms.
  • The upholstered sofa bed is equipped with strong wooden slats, a comfortable padded backrest and two armrests. Please note that the mattress is not included. The recommended mattress heights are 8-14 cm for the upper bed and 12 cm for the lower bed [12 cm recommended if both mattresses are to be flush].
  • Easy to Assemble-The installation instructions of this bed frame are accurate and detailed. You can easily complete all the installation steps according to the instructions. The sofa bed comes in two packages, sometimes the two boxes are not the same. The date has arrived, please wait another 2-3 days or contact our friendly customer service for further assistance.

Descriptions

This modern upholstered sofa bed with pull-out bed frame can be converted from 90 x 200 to 180 x 200 cm. If you're looking for a versatile bed, this pull-out upholstered sofa bed is perfect for you. The high-quality upholstered bed has two armrests, left and right, has a backrest, contains a slatted frame and does not require a box spring bed. The two-in-one structure can not only be used as a youth bed or cot, but also when visiting guests, the pulley bed is the best choice, as it not only saves space, but also looks functional. This upholstered bed is not only beautiful, but also practical. Whether you place it in your bedroom or living room, it's perfect for your diverse needs.
